title: Claude Code (MCP) + Unity, Blender and Pixel Lab (1 Month so far)
author: Cosmonan
selftext:
1 month inside look into my babylonian Mystery Dungeon-like game. Creating game specific agents and skills after the base was set was critical to maintaining claude code performance (20$ account), and Pixel Lab is monstrous. 

There is some polishing required for animations, and so far only got to manually edit the player characters.

comments.author: HugoDzz
comments.body:
I'd maybe polish a bit more the visual effects, it plays a lot in the feeling for pixel art games (even 2.5D ones). I recently shared my [workflow](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude) for getting good vfx out of Claude.

https://reddit.com/link/1xmrhmk/video/gtuho642zezh1/player

comments.author: KhaosPT
comments.body: It's claudes style, it's too tame, too clean. Picks the same colors, same style fojts, UI is a dead giveaway. But it looks okay, it just need a bit of adjustments to add that he ne sais quoi ( on some parts I'm struggling with it too)

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Yeah, I guess so. I'm thinking on using Codex for the artistic direction as it has far better image capabilities.
